reported_symptom.observation: The final two expanded river images align at the bottom but render at visibly different heights.

protected_gold_observation.conclusion: The protected gold snapshot reproduces the mismatch, so unqualified gold parity preserved the defect instead of detecting it.

design_authority.introduced_drift: Round 18 replaced EVIIVE sequence 6 with a 2800x1578 retina source. Its intrinsic source ratio was copied into the frame as 670x377.593 even though the approved Figma frame remained 670x372.

root_cause.classification: intrinsic-source ratio replaced intended frame geometry
root_cause.conclusion: The retina asset swap coupled the source aspect ratio to the layout frame. Existing parity tests treated protected gold as the full design authority and therefore lacked an independent EVIIVE pair contract.

selected_correction.crop_effect: At the 1440px design ratio, cover removes approximately 2.8px from the source at both the top and bottom, about 0.75 percent of source height, while preserving the approved 670x372 frame.
selected_correction.compact_scope: No compact media profile or mobile river behavior changed.

new_recurrence_guards.gold_parity_behavior: Protected gold files remain immutable. The documented post-baseline supersession is applied only in memory before current-vs-gold visual parity.
